title: The Reflexivity Threshold: A Phase Transition for Multi-Agent Performative Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.29577v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many learning systems are performative: once deployed, their predictions change the data distribution on which future models are trained. In multi-agent settings, this feedback is routed through a network of interacting learners, so stability depends not only on the strength of performativity but also on who affects whom. We study repeated retraining in multi-agent performative prediction and identify a spectral threshold that separates stable learning from worst-case learning obstruction. Prior work often collapses cross-agent feedback into a scalar contraction constant, missing this network structure. We instead introduce the reflexivity matrix $\Gamma$, which records how strongly one agent's deployment can move another agent's best response, defined from per-agent gradient sensitivities and curvature parameters. The threshold occurs when the spectral radius of this matrix crosses one. Below the threshold, repeated retraining converges

translated_title: 反身性阈值：多智能体操演性预测中的相变
translated_abstract: 许多学习系统具有操演性：一旦部署，其预测会改变未来模型训练所依赖的数据分布。在多智能体场景中，这种反馈通过一个由相互作用的学习者构成的网络进行传递，因此稳定性不仅取决于操演性的强弱，还取决于谁影响谁。我们研究多智能体操演性预测中的重复再训练问题，并识别出一个谱阈值，它区分了稳定学习与最坏情况下的学习受阻。先前的工作往往将跨智能体的反馈压缩为一个标量收缩常数，从而忽略了这种网络结构。我们转而引入反身性矩阵 $\Gamma$，它记录了一个智能体的部署能在多大程度上移动另一个智能体的最优响应，该矩阵由各智能体的梯度敏感度和曲率参数定义。当该矩阵的谱半径跨越 1 时，阈值出现。低于阈值时，重复再训练收敛（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出用“反身性矩阵”刻画多智能体操演性预测中跨智能体反馈的网络结构，并证明当该矩阵的谱半径越过 1 这一阈值时，重复再训练会发生从稳定收敛到最坏情况学习受阻的相变。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the reflexivity matrix to capture the network structure of cross-agent feedback in multi-agent performative prediction, and shows that when its spectral radius crosses one, repeated retraining undergoes a phase transition from stable convergence to worst-case learning obstruction.
